label: Support between NECESSARY_2 concreta at any admitted world ascends in esse
paraphrase: Open premise, analyst formulation, unattributed: for every admitted world v (accessible from w or not) and concrete candidates a and b that both exist at every world accessible from w, if a exists at v and stands to b in the selected relation at v, then a is more in esse than b. The comparison MoreIn esse is the same supplied comparative as in the Fourth Way premises and takes no world argument, so it is one grade for every world. It does not require support edges to persist between worlds, supporters to be necessary, or b to exist at v.
